Source: AMD FidelityFX SDK 1.1.4 (https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK), FSR 3.1.4's upscaler GLSL passes (`sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu/fsr3upscaler`, `spd`), compiled to SPIR-V as an Eden-family emulator's FSR 3.1 port builds them: reversed depth, HDR colour, render-size motion vectors, no half precision, the SPD passes with and without wave operations. License in LICENSE.txt (MIT).
Use: the SPIR-V is committed in `dm/gfx/vk_android/fsr3/*.h`; `dm/gfx/vk_android/vka_fsr3.c` runs the passes for the DLSS stand-in's FSR 3.1 mode (`DM_VK_DLSS=4`, the Upscaler row's FSR 3.1, `vka_exec.c` `dlss_eval`). The passes, internal images and constants follow the SDK's `ffx_fsr3upscaler.cpp`.
